items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: You know, like Punch and all them kind of fellas play their kind of years.

ctx.x: Your band? Papa Teoh and all. Yeah, Papa Teoh. Yeah.

So, we had a fellow in the band. I know him with Foyer. He was a very fine trumpet player. First triple-tone solo. And he was a fellow. He was out and down. He loved to play Koch. He loved it Koch. Well, he had him on the job. He was on the job about two months, something like that. Got his pocket filled full of money. We played there. Time would knock off, seven, eight o'clock in the morning. Some champagne drinkers come, time, knock off, there they come in while we stay. and we would all go home. He would go to…
